dubtitle_page.auto_cues_desc: Unattended only. A track needs at least this many cues during the scheduled sweep, so a sparse track cannot fluke a match.

providers_page.cache_ttl_hint: How long to cache provider search results before expiring.
providers_page.auto_disable_cooldown_hint: Minutes a provider stays disabled after repeated failures.
providers_page.github_token_hint: Personal access token for higher Marketplace API rate limits.
providers_page.plugins_directory_hint: Path where plugin files are stored. Leave empty to use the default.
providers_page.hot_reload_plugins_hint: Automatically reload plugins when their files change on disk.
providers_page.concurrent_searches_hint: Maximum number of providers searched simultaneously
providers_page.max_subtitle_size_hint: Reject subtitle files larger than this size
providers_page.provider_delay_hint: Milliseconds to wait between each provider request
providers_page.provider_reranking_hint: Reorder provider results based on historical download success rates.
providers_page.reranking_min_downloads_hint: Minimum download count before a provider is eligible for reranking.
providers_page.reranking_max_modifier_hint: Maximum score modifier applied by reranking (e.g. 0.3 = ±30%).
providers_page.dynamic_timeouts_hint: Automatically adjust search timeouts based on provider response history.
providers_page.dyn_timeout_min_samples_hint: Minimum number of response samples before dynamic adjustment kicks in.
providers_page.dyn_timeout_multiplier_hint: Multiply the measured average response time by this factor for the timeout.
providers_page.dyn_timeout_buffer_hint: Fixed seconds added on top of the calculated dynamic timeout.
providers_page.dyn_timeout_min_hint: Minimum timeout regardless of dynamic calculation.
providers_page.dyn_timeout_max_hint: Maximum timeout cap even if dynamic calculation exceeds it.
providers_page.circuit_breaker_threshold_hint: Number of consecutive failures before a provider is temporarily disabled.
providers_page.circuit_breaker_cooldown_hint: Seconds a provider stays in OPEN state before being retried.

translation_backends.default_backend_help: Used for translations unless a language profile overrides it.
translation_backends.default_backend_unconfigured_warn: This backend has no API key yet — translation would fail. Configure it below.
translation_backends.request_timeout_help: Timeout for each LLM API request. Increase for slow or large models. Default: 90.
translation_backends.backoff_base_help: Base interval for exponential backoff on retries. Default: 5.
translation_backends.context_window_help: Number of lines before and after each batch sent as context to the LLM. 0 = disabled.
translation_backends.default_sync_engine_help: Engine used by auto-sync when no per-request override is given. alass = audio-based alignment; ffsubsync = frame-rate-based.
translation_backends.toast_sync_engine_save_failed: Failed to save sync engine preference
translation_backends.auto_sync_after_download_help: Automatically syncs downloaded subtitles against the video file (ffsubsync only).
translation_backends.auto_sync_engine_help: Engine for automatic synchronization. alass is skipped during auto-sync (requires reference track).
translation_backends.use_episode_context_desc: Include previous episode subtitle as context for translation
translation_backends.context_episodes_desc: Number of prior episodes to include as context
translation_backends.auto_series_glossary_desc: Automatically build a per-series glossary from translation history
translation_backends.toast_template_applied: Template applied — open the "{{name}}" backend card to add your API key and save
translation_backends.backends_available: {{count}} translation backends available — expand to configure and test
translation_backends.no_backends_registered: No translation backends registered. Install backend packages (e.g. deepl, openai, google-cloud-translate) to enable them.
translation_backends.global_llm_desc: Defaults for the Ollama/LLM pipeline. A backend configured individually (in its card) uses its own values and ignores these globals.

prompt_presets_tab.toast_fields_required: Name and prompt template are required

prompt_presets_tab.no_presets: No prompt presets configured. A default preset will be created automatically.

translation_quality.title: Translation Quality
translation_quality.intro: Lines scoring below threshold are retried up to max retries.
translation_quality.enable_help: Score each translated line after translation and retry low-quality results.
translation_quality.threshold_help: Lines scoring below this value are retried. Default: 50.
translation_quality.max_retries_help: Max retry attempts per line when quality is below threshold. Default: 2.
translation_quality.temperature_help: LLM sampling temperature. Lower values are more deterministic; 0.1–0.3 recommended for translation. Default: 0.3.
translation_quality.batch_size_help: Number of subtitle lines sent to the LLM per request. Smaller batches are slower but use less context. Default: 15.

connections_metadata.title: Metadata API Keys
connections_metadata.cache_ttl_desc: How long metadata is cached before a refresh.
connections_metadata.section_desc: API keys for metadata providers (TMDB, TheTVDB)

post_processing_tab.title: Post-Processing Pipeline
post_processing_tab.subtitle: Run actions after a subtitle is downloaded, translated, or synced.

security_tab.pw_too_short: New password must be at least 8 characters.
security_tab.allowed_ip_ranges_hint: Comma-separated CIDR ranges. Empty = allow all.

translation_memory_section.title: Translation Memory
translation_memory_section.enable_help: Reuse previously translated lines that are similar to new ones, reducing LLM calls and improving consistency.
translation_memory_section.threshold_help: Minimum similarity (0.0–1.0) for a cached translation to be reused. 1.0 = exact match only; 0.8 = near-identical lines reused.
translation_memory_section.clear_confirm_message: Clear all cached translations? This cannot be undone.

subtitle_automation_page.title: Subtitle Automation
subtitle_automation_page.subtitle: One-click pipeline for embedded extract, SDH handling, and foreign-track cleanup

master.title: Automation
master.description: Master switch for the entire pipeline. When off, the sub-toggles below are honored individually.
master.label: Enable full automation
master.help: On: embedded subs auto-extract, SDH is a valid fallback, and foreign-language tracks can be cleaned from containers.

queue.title: Auto-Extract Queue
queue.description: Drain worker that runs until every pending embedded extract has landed on disk.
queue.enabled_help: Processes new library items automatically. Falls back to the legacy "Auto-Extract on scan" behavior when off.
queue.interval_help: Scheduler cadence. Lower = more responsive, higher = lower CPU.

sdh.title: SDH Tolerance
sdh.description: Whether SDH/CC tracks (Subtitles for Deaf / Hard-of-Hearing) are acceptable sources.
sdh.allow_help: Many Disney/Marvel rips only ship English as SDH. Keep this on unless you truly never want SDH extracted.
sdh.penalty_help: Points subtracted from SDH tracks so a non-SDH track wins a tie.

cleanup.title: Foreign-Track Cleanup
cleanup.description: After extraction succeeds, remove non-target-language subtitle tracks from the container. Backups go to the trash folder — nothing is permanently deleted.
cleanup.default_help: Global default; per-series overrides live on the series settings panel.
cleanup.keep_und_help: Preserve tracks where the language tag is "und". Leave off unless your library has unlabelled subs you want to keep.

pipeline.autoTranslateHint: Automatically translate downloaded subtitles to the target language.
pipeline.anySourceHint: Translate the missing target from whatever source subtitle exists (any language), preferring the profile/default source. Off: only the preferred source language is used.
pipeline.providerMultilangHint: Search providers for source subtitles in multiple languages (more matches, more API usage). Only applies when "any source" is on.
pipeline.autoSyncHint: Automatically synchronise subtitles to video timing after download.
pipeline.autoCleanupHint: Remove duplicate and redundant subtitle files automatically after extract.
pipeline.title: Processing Pipeline
pipeline.description: Control post-download processing: translation, synchronisation, and cleanup.
